text.tspan: "Give thanks in all circumstances;
for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus."
- Exalt God for His mercies endures forever
- Thank God for the gift of salvation
- Thank God for another day
- Thank God for provision, protection,
guidance that semester
- Thank God for MOUT for this far
Thank God for being with us that semester and
preserving us.
Pray that God may be with us in the remaining
part of the semester.
Pray for Our institution, the students, staffs and
leadership and administration.
Pray that God may take over in our institution.
Those who trust in the LORD Are like Mount Zion, Which cannot
be moved, but abides forever.
DAY 5: FRIDAY
Praying for our Academics and Jkuat at Large
